title: A diagnostic read returns values as stored and refuses a result that includes a declared secret column, naming the column and telling the reader to select specific columns.
verification: Focused disposable-database tests in runtime/api/domain/handlers/test_db_read.py cover unredacted values in columns named token, secret and credential, the db_read_secret_column_refused refusal for organizations.events_signing_key selected directly, aliased or through SELECT *, and other organizations columns returning normally. No deployed run proof yet.
